basis: i_v2 executor plus identical prefetch sequencer; use independent i_rom unchanged

sha2.path: token[60] -> register read selection ->22bit LOAD address adder -> >=108 -> error/state

shake.path: token[59] -> register read selection -> arithmetic/result legality -> context CE

physical_cut.data_source: ADD and shifts use only staged_control_read0/1; memory address adders use only staged_control_read0/1. No live/fast mux on these operands.
physical_cut.fast_unary: INC/XOR1 read DST directly through narrow_register_read rather than an opcode-dependent shared source selector.
physical_cut.retirement: Existing CONTROL_OPERANDS executes pure operations and retires the sequencer on same edge. LOAD/STORE keep WAIT_CONTROL until actual RAM completion.
physical_cut.memory: All LOADs register read address in CONTROL_OPERANDS before CONTROL_LOAD; all STORE addresses are validated then latched before writing.
physical_cut.other_slow_reads: FORS_TARGET/DIGIT stay physically absent from fast register reader and are captured as in i_v2.

invariants: No state enumeration, ports, ROM format, ISA or software program changes
Each Hash still requires explicit HASH template; no hardware CHAIN/TREE added
No timing exceptions or P/U specializations
Existing legality checks and rejected STORE no-side-effect retained
measurement_status: No synthesis/route/profile started by this agent; parent owns frozen candidate measurement.
